title: Chill with You: Lo-Fi Story 1st anniversary: free story update on 25 Nov and Room & Cozy Activity DLC announced (Nestopi)

sources.name: Nestopi press release, 7 Nov 2026 (reproduced in full by Automaton JP and Denfaminicogamer)
Steam store page of the DLC (coming soon)

first_report: Nestopi press release 7 Nov 2026 (Saturday, JST), carried by Denfami and Automaton 18:00 Dubai; Steam DLC page live the same day
footage: Steam trailer PV_EN2 of the base game (app 3548580, Nestopi); the DLC Steam page has no trailer yet (appdetails movies empty, checked 7 Nov 15:00Z). No stills needed.

claims.text: Nestopi announced on 7 Nov a free large story update 'Kimi to miru yume' showing Satone one year later, due 25 Nov on Steam and smartphones
claims.status: read in the Nestopi release text as reproduced by Denfami and Automaton

claims.text: Paid DLC Room & Cozy Activity: new 'my pace' status, new work places bed and stairs, 100+ new lines; Steam 25 Nov, App Store and Google Play early Dec; price undecided; later updates add kitchen and loft
claims.status: same release; Steam DLC page confirms coming soon (Steam lists 24 Nov, the US-time date of the 25 Nov JST release)

claims.text: The game turns one year old (Steam release 17 Nov 2025)

angle.hook: A one-year-old cozy study game is getting a free story chapter showing Satone a year later
angle.why_now: Announced today for the first anniversary; both land on 25 Nov
angle.players_here: Free on Steam and phones; Arabic is not among the listed languages (Japanese, English, Chinese, Portuguese, Russian, Korean), so the news is stated without implying Arabic support
angle.payoff: 25 Nov for the free update; the DLC price is not announced
